newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ITALIAN MALE STRIPTEASE ARTISTS FORM A TEAM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ITALIAN MALE STRIPTEASE ARTISTS FORM A TEAM.

text.p: Italian male striptease artists, coached by a former professional player, revealed plans on Tuesday to form a "national" soccer team to raise money for charity.
The self-styled Italian National Striptease Soccer Federation (FINCS) said they would train twice a week and play together every two weeks.
A spokesman said they would play in white and blue shirts rather than their usual working attire.
"No loin-cloths, we preferred a classical uniform," said captain and federation president 'Nicolas'. "After all, we are professional strip-artists, not gigolos."
They will be coached by former Roma defender Enzo Romano, who runs a gym in the Adriatic seaside resort of Riccione.
Soccer-mad Italy already has several celebrity soccer teams made up of singers, politicians, magistrates and actors who play each other to raise funds for the needy.
The striptease artists said they had already found some sponsors. "It's an opportunity to get together and help those in need, and maybe regain some image," said one of them.
